name: Centered Hero
best_for: title slides,section dividers,key statements,call-to-action slides,quote slides
description: Full-bleed centered layout with a dominant headline and minimal supporting content. Decorative elements (particles, gradients, geometric shapes) live in the background layer. Maximum visual impact with minimal cognitive load. Headline occupies 60-70% of vertical space.

name: Split Panel
description: 50/50 vertical split with content on the left and a visual on the right (or reversed). The visual area bleeds to the edge. Content area has internal padding. Works well with a strong image or product screenshot. Can shift to 60/40 for content-heavy or visual-heavy slides.

name: Grid Cards
css_grid_template: grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); grid-template-rows: auto repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 1.5rem;
content_areas: slide-title, card-1(icon+title+body), card-2, card-3, card-4, card-5, card-6
best_for: feature showcases,team grids,pricing tiers,benefit lists,comparison matrices,portfolio thumbnails
description: Title row spanning full width above a 2×3 or 3×2 card grid. Each card has an icon/image zone, a card title, and 1-2 lines of body text. Cards have consistent height via auto rows. Responsive: collapses to 2-col or 1-col at smaller container widths. Best for parallel, equal-weight content items.

name: Editorial Stack
css_grid_template: grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto auto; grid-template-columns: 1fr; max-width: 860px; margin: 0 auto;
best_for: narrative slides,story telling,process steps,data-driven insights,long-form explanations,methodology
description: Vertical editorial flow inspired by magazine layouts. Top: small uppercase section label or step number. Below: large headline (2-3 lines max). Body: 60-80 word paragraph in a comfortable reading width. Bottom: a pull quote, key stat, or visual footnote. Left-aligned reading gravity. White space is intentional.

name: Dashboard
content_areas: slide-title, metric-card-1, metric-card-2, metric-card-3, chart-large(colspan 2), insight-panel
best_for: data reports,KPI reviews,analytics summaries,financial overviews,status updates,metrics presentations
description: Top bar with slide title and time period. Three equal metric cards with large number + label + trend indicator. Below: a large chart taking 2/3 width and a insights/legend panel taking 1/3. Designed for data density without clutter. Uses subtle borders and background variation to segment zones.
